batch: T10-AUTH5 private export gate (wF:p4, Claude continued grok work)
scope: Pure Node, compiled actual source, synthetic primitives and an explicitly labeled Fake Runtime gate. No browser, no Playwright, no worker-entry, no provider, no deploy.
commands: ./node_modules/.bin/eslint packages/browser/src packages/browser/test   # = pnpm lint 的 browser 子集

falsifiedInterface.binding: AuthSessionBinding gains status: AuthSessionStatus; construction requires status === "active"
falsifiedInterface.grant: AuthExportGrant = frozen binding tuple + grantId + deadline + kind: "capture_auth_state" + private captureTicket; unknown keys rejected
falsifiedInterface.gate: AuthExecutionGate.authorizeExport({binding, grant}) is required; missing gate/method refuses at construction (no default-allow)
falsifiedInterface.export: exportAuthState(grant, signal?): freeze/copy -> shape -> abort -> tuple (incl. expiresAt) -> deadline -> synchronous grantId claim -> await gate -> active/deadline re-check -> exportState -> active/deadline re-check -> approved-state validation
falsifiedInterface.noLegacyExport: the old no-argument exportAuthState path is removed, not deprecated
falsifiedInterface.ticketHandling: captureTicket crosses only the gate boundary; it is registered as redaction material so it cannot appear in a later snapshot or error
falsifiedInterface.sharedGrantLedger: executeAuth and exportAuthState share one grantId ledger, so an id consumed once cannot be replayed through either path

privatePortCases.name: four actions call only injected primitives and fill redacts every slot
prepare_state validates and does not navigate
repeat and overlap of one grant do not execute twice
gate failure, abort, deadline, and tampering cause zero side effects
invalid approved state does not prepare or navigate
async gate sees a frozen permit and later snapshots keep prior secrets out
missing gate, missing export gate, and non-active binding are refused at construction
export needs a well-formed grant, the exact tuple, a live deadline and no abort
a capture grant exports once, only through the fake runtime gate
duplicate and overlapping exports of one grant never run twice
a grant mutated during a blocked gate cannot change what is approved or exported
gate rejection, abort, expiry and close during a capture return no material
the private ticket never appears in a returned snapshot or error
export in flight rejects after close, abort, or expiry
grant accessors, cycles, and non-plain grants are rejected without running getters

notProven: no real Runtime capture-ticket CAS, no Coordinator/Worker wiring, no ciphertext submission: the positive path is a Fake Runtime gate only
no real browser/session.ts integration; session.ts is untouched
no service-side guarantee that a ticket is single-use or that the gate verifies the binding from the database
Ego/real-browser verification stays paused per the batch decision
